summary.text: Ted Combes is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 16, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia's campaign-finance listing records that Ted Combes lost the 2022 general election for New Hampshire House of Representatives Rockingham 16.
